title: A released run key can be claimed again, so an item released and later reclaimed moves through coord without a manual put
goal: coord.py transition accepts released to claimed (and states the reclaim in the table), so a released item is claimed again without a manual put on its run key

run:
import subprocess, tempfile, os, sys, json
S = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), "c.sqlite")
def c(*a): return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/coord.py", "--store", S, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
first = [c("transition", "run/ST-00000000", "--to", s).returncode for s in ("claimed", "released")]
again = c("transition", "run/ST-00000000", "--to", "claimed").returncode
print("claim, release", first, "claim again", again)
sys.exit(0 if first == [0, 0] and again == 0 else 1)
